# Empire OS: reference architecture

> How one person runs 9 governed AI agents on an 8 GB Mac mini with test-gated releases: tiers, governance model, release process and ADRs.

Sanitised public showcase by Dr. Ravi Teja Thiriveedhi (clinician turned AI systems architect). Scope and limits: [TRUST.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/empire-os-reference-architecture/blob/main/TRUST.md).

## Docs

- [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/empire-os-reference-architecture/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): The five tiers in detail
- [docs/governance.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/empire-os-reference-architecture/blob/main/docs/governance.md): Autonomy levels, risk classes, kill switch, audit log
- [docs/release-process.md](https://github.com/sterilefield/empire-os-reference-architecture/blob/main/docs/release-process.md): Spec, AI builder, review, release gate
- [docs/adr/](https://github.com/sterilefield/empire-os-reference-architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/): Architecture decision records
